facts.text: I have been trying to get into a consistent sleep schedule.
I have been trying to establish a bedtime routine to wake up feeling more refreshed.
I have been trying to do yoga in the evenings to unwind.
I skip yoga on Fridays and Mondays.
I watch TV around 8 pm every evening after finishing dinner.
I have been trying to reduce my screen time before bed.
It is hard for me to reduce screen time before bed when I am in the middle of a good show.
I want to set reminders on my phone to remind me to start winding down for bed.
